result.rationale: In packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts, refreshOAuthTokens returns the axios response when disabled (which has .data) but when credential sync is enabled it returns a raw fetch Response from CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT (per refreshOAuthTokens.ts: `const response = await fetch(...); return response;`). The caller then does `if (!tokenInfo.data.error)`, and a fetch Response has no `.data` property, so `.data.error` throws TypeError under sync mode. Mechanism fully verifiable from the diff.

judged_text: In sharing mode tokenInfo is a raw fetch Response, and `if (!tokenInfo.data.error)` dereferences Response.data which is undefined, throwing TypeError. Under credential sync every Zoho Bigin token refresh crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading error)', so Bigin calendar operations fail for self-hosters using the sync endpoint.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh path now does `const tokenInfo = await refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId);` and later dereferences `tokenInfo.data.error`. But `refreshOAuthTokens` (new in `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`) returns a raw `fetch(...)` Response object when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is truthy. A `Response` has no `.data`, so `tokenInfo.data` is `undefined` and `tokenInfo.data.error` will throw a TypeError in sharing/sync mode. This is directly introduced by the diff.
